provenance: authored synthetic 11v11 fixture, 10 Hz, 105 x 68 m; no real-match data

window.off_ball_basis: supplied constant carrier identity through pass release

space.method: single-run endpoint sensitivity; runner position AND velocity updated; all other state frozen at start

accounting.note: Residual includes defenders, ball, nonlinear interactions and other state changes; not synergy alone.

defender_selection: up to two nearest outfield defenders within start radius; association is not causation

receiving_window.method: left-interval samples satisfying onside, separation, control and straight-lane clearance thresholds; not pass completion probability

shot_context.description: authored shot event; scoring outcome not asserted

limitations: Synthetic trajectories are authored, not an empirical validation on real matches.
Frozen-player counterfactuals measure model sensitivity, not causal defender responses.
Pitch-control surface does not filter offside players; candidate receiver onside is checked separately.
Grid-cell centres approximate region boundaries; area depends on grid resolution.
Defender travel is observed distance, not energy or distance caused by the runner.
Window duration is threshold-dependent; the geometric lane rule omits ball flight interception.
No xG model is trained or inferred.
